answer: The agreement remains in effect for two (2) years from January 15, 2026. However, the obligations to maintain confidentiality and non-use survive for five (5) years following the date of initial disclosure, and Trade Secrets remain protected in perpetuity under applicable law.
supporting_quotes: This Agreement shall remain in effect for a period of two (2) years from the Effective Date.

The confidentiality and non-use obligations set forth herein shall survive the termination or expiration of this Agreement and continue for a period of five (5) years following the date of initial disclosure, except with respect to Trade Secrets, which shall remain protected in perpetuity under applicable law.
